messages:
Maria G: quick sync from the postmortem follow-up board — shard memory blowups still trending on 03/19. need an owner list, short vs long term fix plan, and weekly visibility.

Ajay P: high level plan: (A) immediate circuit breakers + export-only heap scans, (B) medium-term eviction/ageing heuristics, (C) long-term allocator compaction and slab aging.

Jamie L: I'll run targeted heap scans and attach flamegraphs. running `curl -s http://canary:6060/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap.prof && go tool pprof -png /tmp/heap.prof > /tmp/heap.png` tonight. will also collect `pprof/allocs` for delta diffs.

Sylvie K: short-term: add an OOM-guard softcap that rejects *new* large prefixes when RSS > 68%. also throttle background writes for heavy prefixes. canary rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 2h observation windows.

Tomas: telemetry tasks: add `kv.prefix_inflight_bytes` and `kv.fragmentation_ratio` to the RRDs. create alert: `FRAG_RATIO > 0.35 for 15m` and a separate `KV_RSS_GROWTH > 20%/30m`. linking dashboard when ready.

Leah R: ops ask: pre-built rollback playbook for softcap required. include quick toggle metric and a `curl` endpoint to disable. I'll own the playbook.

Ajay P: prototype compaction worker in branch `feature/kv-compactor-v2`. it'll be opt-in initially; goal: reduce fragmentation by reclaiming aged free slabs. estimate 3 weeks to alpha.

Maria G: concrete milestones: heap scans + artifacts by 2026-03-22, softcap canary deploy 2026-03-23, telemetry & alerts by 2026-03-21, compaction alpha by 2026-04-10. confirm owners & slack updates cadence (weekly).

Jamie L: confirmed for scans (2026-03-22). will post artifacts in #eng-runtime and attach to the postmortem doc.

Sylvie K: confirmed for softcap rollout (2026-03-23). will prepare config flags: `--kv-softcap=0.68 --kv-evict-threshold=0.6` and the rollback endpoint: `POST /admin/kv/softcap/disable`.

Tomas: confirmed for telemetry (2026-03-21). will add Grafana panels for top-20 prefixes by inflight bytes.

Leah R: confirmed for rollback playbook. will add runbook steps and CLI snippet. ops-bot: please pin the playbook link in the incident channel.

ops-bot: Runbook updated: `kv-memory-blowup` now includes softcap toggle and compaction opt-in flag. pinned in #incidents.

Maria G: tracking: I'll maintain a tiny follow-up doc and keep the weekly status. also, please add regression tests that exercise eviction behavior under heavy prefix churn.

Jamie L: adding an automation test: `ci/tests/kv_prefix_churn_test.sh` that simulates 10k prefix churn at 500 rps for 30s.

Sylvie K: also planning a canary that induces fragmentation without increasing traffic by using lots of mid-size items — helps validate compaction.

Ajay P: will add safety nets in compactor: max 5% CPU, backoff if rss rises, and a dry-run mode that reports reclaimable bytes. design doc link: https://redwood.internal/design/kv-compactor-v2 (draft)

Maria G: please open JIRA tickets for each action and paste them here. I'll close the loop in Monday triage.

Ajay P: created tickets KV-3601(KV compactor design), KV-3602(compactor impl), KV-3603(softcap rollout). linking: https://jira.redwood/browse/KV-3601

Leah R: created playbook ticket KV-3604. ops runbook will be in `/runbooks/kv-memory-playbook.md`.

Tomas: telemetry ticket KV-3605 for alerts/dashboards.

Maria G: thanks all. weekly check-ins on Wed 10am. if anyone hits a blocker, post in #eng-runtime and @me. re-opening thread once artifacts land. :white_check_mark:
